 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # Divider color is the most common color, and its mostly-uniform rows/cols
    # mark the lattice. Colored exceptions at lattice crossings are the clues.
    divider = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == divider for x in grid[r]) >= w - 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) >= h - 2]
    nondivider = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    fill = nondivider.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            if corners[0] != divider and len(set(corners)) == 1:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
